scope: Seven ordinary Manual images, 24 admitted distinct workers per image, six buildings; original holdouts and other-purpose images remain outside primary comparison.
identity: object_id selects the frozen admitted response; worker_id is current W identity, while subset uses the legacy P alias. image/person alone is not an inventory record key because excluded/source duplicates may remain.
labels: For each target image, current B8L2/D10 and T_source effects are from the fold excluding the entire target building. Q>0 is relatively high, Q<0 relatively low. T<0 is faster, T>0 slower; insufficient support is unknown. Q +/-2 boundary is diagnostic, not a confidence interval.
quality: B8L2/D10 are the unchanged published single-layout formulas applied to frozen final fusion geometry and one specified reference. Missing means unavailable, never zero. D10 shares exactly the B8L2 mask.
complete_evaluable: At least four selected wall-line nodes and algorithmically valid full geometry. This is computable geometric completeness, not certified wall identity, semantic correctness, absence of omitted necessary detail, or an individual worker reliability judgment.
k2: Existing policy defers connection/quality at two people. Retain all k2 attempts and mark policy status separately from other incomplete outputs.
raw_R: Mean over original annotation pairs in the current team of symmetric-difference area divided by the union area of the fixed full 24-person image pool. k=1 is undefined, not zero. Do not change the denominator to a class-specific union. E[R] is constant in k for the uniform finite-pool samples used here; path changes are not convergence evidence.
V: Mean 1 minus footprint IoU between two realized teams at the same image/k/strategy, only if both have complete evaluable footprints. Pair denominator is the two-output union, different from raw_R. Keep pair count, completeness, shared members, identical subsets and pool size; overlaps and repeats are not independent images.
adjacent_change: A difference between two actual nested prefixes of one saved permutation. Identity/vote changes are algorithm process diagnostics, not adjudicated personal mistakes. Incomplete states keep missing geometry/quality changes.
time: source_active_time_seconds and target_matched_time_seconds remain separate. Prefix total exists only when every member has compatible positive measured time. Known sums of partial coverage are explicitly partial. Total is annotation labor time, not collaborative elapsed duration or computational fusion runtime.
fixed_base_time: With an unchanged seven-person base, compare actual active time of alternative eighth members where observed. This does not impute the base's missing cost. Quality comparisons on time-known rows are separate from quality comparisons on all scoreable rows.
aggregation: For fixed-base contrasts, average bases within image, then images within building, then six buildings equally. For strategy paths, average repetitions within each image/k/strategy, then pair strategies, then average buildings. Every endpoint has its own observed base/image/building denominator.
selection_stage1: Existing 24 random full permutations: six highest/lowest first-eight mean out-of-building Q schedules are selected without inspecting geometry outcomes. This finite-shortlist diagnostic preserves their true original prefixes.
selection_stage2: Registered extension: 8 high, 4 high+4 low, 8 low, random eight from 24; seed 20261017, 12 explicit distinct-person orders per strategy/image, true k1..8 recomputation. This is development-stage finite-panel evidence, not a fresh blind test.
class_boundary: Primary class pools have 10-12 high and 12-14 low workers. H=8 never exhausts a true class pool. Smaller class pools nevertheless increase member overlap and can reduce V without proving greater intrinsic homogeneity.
severity_scope_Semi: Cleaned Manual fusion teams do not recover excluded responses as votes. Team geometric failure must not be counted as a serious personal error. New S/Semi/severity profiles would require target-building-excluded evidence and opportunity/unknown denominators before being used for member selection.
statistical_status: Six buildings, seven images; no inferential sample-size inflation from 4032 existing states, 2688 stage2 states, 46368 stage1 path pairs, 14784 stage2 path pairs, or 4076 legacy overlapping replacement pairs. No null-hypothesis significance search or post-outcome reclassification.
